title: Home centred, and the Level box opens the Stamp book
problem: On taller phones Home leaves a large empty space between the mode cards and the bottom strip, and the Level box looks like a button but does nothing.
scope: The stall row and the mode cards sit in the middle of the space between the title and the bottom strip
The Level box on Home becomes a button (44 px or taller) that opens the Stamp book
exclusions: No rule, save or mode change

acceptance.evidence: npm run verify: 1226 passed, 1 skipped (as before)

acceptance.text: Home still fits one screen at 412x915, 393x852, 390x844, 375x667 and 360x640, with a saved game in every mode and a 14-letter name
acceptance.evidence: Measured in scratchpad p121/fit.cjs: page height equals screen height at every size; at 412x915 the space above and below the middle block is even (56 px each, plus the 12 px gap)

acceptance.text: Tapping the Level box opens the Stamp book
acceptance.evidence: Browser check at 412x915 and 360x640: after the tap the Stamp book screen shows; the box is 44 px tall

approval.evidence: Owner, 2026-11-23 (with a screenshot of Home at Level 6): "make it so that its more centred and the level 6 box opens up to the stamp box"

added: The Level box on Home opens the Stamp book
changed: Home centres the stall and the mode cards between the title and the bottom strip

playerNotes: Home is centred on taller phones, and tapping your level opens the Stamp book
